description: This PHP source file defines the view class Jjwg_MapsViewMap_Markers for rendering a Google Maps display within the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Maps'. It includes methods for initializing the map, adding markers and custom areas, setting up controls and clustering, and integrating data tables for marker data management.
